A Human '''singer''' performed a series of concerts on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. A [[Concert Every Night/Legends|series of posters]] were put up around [[Galactic City/Legends|the city]] in order to promote them. The [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] caption read "concert every night"<ref name="Lethal">{{TCW|Lethal Trackdown}}</ref> – "call 050506".<ref name="SW-Lethal Trackdown Concept Art Gallery">{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/lethal-trackdown-concept-art-gallery|text="Lethal Trackdown" Concept Art Gallery}} {{C|Slide 7}}</ref>
